Adjustment.description: A signed, labelled amount added to the free cash flow of a period.

label.description: What the amount is, for example "Disposal of a warehouse". Not empty.

value.description:
Amount in currency units: positive for an inflow (for example proceeds from a disposal),
negative for an outflow.

FreeCashFlowPeriod.description: The build-up of one period, every component in currency units.

change_in_net_working_capital.description: Change in net working capital as given (positive for an increase).

free_cash_flow_to_equity.description: FCFE of the period; `null` without financing lines.

interest_after_taxes.description: Interest expense − interest tax shield; `null` without financing lines.

interest_expense.description: Interest expense as given; `null` without financing lines.

interest_tax_rate.description:
Rate t of the interest tax shield applied in this period: 0 where the `zero` treatment
of a negative EBIT applies (SPEC-0001 amendment 14); `null` without financing lines.
The shield applied is `interest_tax_shield`: under `zero` it can be below
t × interest expense, when EBIT is below the interest (SPEC-0001 Decision 22).

interest_tax_shield.description:
Interest tax shield of the period: t × interest expense; under the `zero` treatment
t × min(interest expense, max(EBIT, 0)), the deduction limited to the taxable income
available (SPEC-0001 Decision 22); `null` without financing lines.

net_borrowing.description: Net borrowing as given; `null` without financing lines.

operating_taxes.description: Taxes on EBIT used: computed from the rate, or as given.

other_adjustments_total.description: Sum of the adjustments (0 when none is given).

NegativeEbit.description: Tax on a negative EBIT when the taxes are computed from a rate (SPEC-0001 R4).

oneOf.description: Taxes = rate × EBIT also when EBIT is negative: a tax saving that raises the flow.
No tax when EBIT is negative.

TaxForm.description: How the taxes on EBIT were given (SPEC-0001 Decision 7).

oneOf.description: `notional_tax_rate` applied to the EBIT of every period.

free_cash_flows_to_equity.description: FCFE of periods 1..n, in currency units, not discounted; `null` without financing lines.

free_cash_flows_to_firm.description: FCFF of periods 1..n, in currency units, not discounted.

interest_tax_rate.description:
Rate t of the interest tax shield of the tax form: the tax rate on EBIT, or the given
`interest_tax_rate`; `null` without financing lines. The rate applied in each period is
`periods[].interest_tax_rate`, 0 where the `zero` treatment applies.

negative_ebit.description: Negative EBIT treatment of the rate form; `null` in the amounts form.
